description: Dusty shelves stretch into the darkness. One book holds the key.

items.name: Leather Journal
items.hint: The ink is faded, talking only of lost cities.

items.name: Silver Compass
items.hint: It doesn't point North, but towards the truth.
items.solutionText: The hidden door opens behind the shelf!

items.name: Inkwell
items.hint: Empty and dry for decades.

items.name: Old Mirror
items.hint: You see a reflection of someone you don't recognize.

items.name: Wooden Music Box
items.hint: The melody reveals a code: 4-2-9.
items.solutionText: The safe in the corner clicks open!

items.name: Tattered Map
items.hint: It shows a place that no longer exists.

description: Silver flowers bloom under the pale light.

items.name: Crystal Rose
items.hint: It feels cold to the touch, humming softly.

items.name: Iron Key
items.hint: The teeth of the key match the garden gate.
items.solutionText: The gate swings open to the Secret Grove!

items.name: Stone Fountain
items.hint: The water flows upwards.

description: Bubbling potions and strange smells fill the air.

items.name: Blue Flask
items.hint: It smells like ozone and thunderstorms.

items.name: Gold Scale
items.hint: It weighs the soul, and it finds you honest.

items.name: Dried Mandrake
items.hint: It looks like a screaming baby.

description: Water presses in from all sides, bioluminescent fish swim by.

items.name: Rusty Anchor
items.hint: Too heavy to move, too old to care.

items.name: Pearl Necklace
items.hint: The pearls glow when you whisper a secret.
items.solutionText: The Captain's chest reveals its gold!

items.name: Torn Logbook
items.hint: Water has erased the final entry.

description: Gears grind and steam hisses everywhere.

items.name: Brass Gear
items.hint: A small piece of a much larger machine.

items.name: Winding Key
items.hint: It fits the master clock perfectly.
items.solutionText: Time freezes, revealing a hidden path!

items.name: Oil Can
items.hint: Just makes things slippery.

description: A miracle of water in a sea of sand.

items.name: Palm Leaf
items.hint: Provides a moment of shade.

items.name: Glass Sphere
items.hint: It shows a vision of a rainstorm.
items.solutionText: The oasis expands into a lush forest!

items.name: Old Sandals
items.hint: Worn down by a thousand miles.

description: Wind howls and frost bites the skin.

items.name: Ice Shard
items.hint: Sharp enough to cut through shadow.

items.name: Eternal Flame
items.hint: It burns without fuel, warming the soul.

items.name: Fur Cloak
items.hint: Keeps you warm, but doesn't help you find the way.

description: Light is a memory here, and whispers are real.

items.name: Void Lantern
items.hint: It casts shadows of things that aren't there.

items.name: Light Fragment
items.hint: A tiny piece of the sun, blindingly bright.
items.solutionText: The shadows retreat, revealing the exit!

items.name: Obsidian Blade
items.hint: It cuts through the silence.

description: Grass islands drift in a sapphire sky.

items.name: Cloud Feather
items.hint: Lighter than air, it drifts upward.

items.name: Gravity Stone
items.hint: It pulls you toward the center of the world.
items.solutionText: You leap across the gap to the Final Isle!

items.name: Wind Chime
items.hint: It rings when the storm approaches.
